# Overview

Methods 2.9.3 (reduced-block sub-B-PLS). For every reduced-block run and each
of its LVs: permutation p, % cross-block covariance, and the absolute Pearson
correlation between its BSR map and each primary LV's BSR map across all
20,706 edges. These are the numbers in Results 3.3.2 and in Figures 2D / S4D.

**Outputs**

- `outputs/cross_comparison/reduced_block_summary.csv`
- `outputs/supplement/FigureS2{A,B,C,D}_<run>_reduced_block.png` — Figures S2A–D, one per
  reduced-block run (A SBP, B Age, C TC, D Education; numbers from `params$pls_runs`), sub-LV1
  only (composites built by 03)
- `outputs/<segment>/reduced_block_<run>_subLV1_subLV2.png` — the full figure for each run,
  sub-LV1 above sub-LV2 (working output)

```{r load-packages}
pacman::p_load(here, tidyverse, R.matlab, patchwork, knitr)
```

```{r summary}
primary_id <- pls_runs_by_role("primary")
sub_runs   <- pls_runs_by_role("sensitivity")
mat_path   <- function(rid) here::here("data", "matlab_io", "output",
                                       params$pls_runs[[rid]]$segment, "bpls_result.mat")

primary <- read_bpls(mat_path(primary_id))
lvs     <- params$report_lv_names

summary_df <- map_dfr(sub_runs, function(rid) {
  sp <- read_bpls(mat_path(rid))
  map_dfr(seq_along(sp$perm_p), function(i) {
    tibble(run = rid, label = params$pls_runs[[rid]]$label, sub_lv = paste0("LV", i),
           perm_p = sp$perm_p[i], pct_cov = pct_covariance(sp$s)[i],
           !!!setNames(map(lvs, ~ abs(cor(primary$bsr[, as.integer(sub("LV", "", .x))], sp$bsr[, i]))),
                       paste0("abs_r_primary_", lvs)))
  })
})

kable(summary_df, digits = 3)
write_csv(summary_df, shared_output_path("cross_comparison", "reduced_block_summary.csv"))
```

# Figures S2A–D (reduced-block runs)

```{r reduced-block-figures, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 24}
run_path <- function(seg, f) shared_output_path(seg, f)
for (rid in sub_runs) {
  seg <- params$pls_runs[[rid]]$segment
  rows <- map(c("LV1", "LV2"), function(lv) {
    s <- summary_df %>% filter(run == rid, sub_lv == lv)
    # wrap_elements keeps each composite's own title and A-C panel tags
    wrap_elements(full = readRDS(here::here("outputs", seg, sprintf("%s_composite.rds", tolower(lv)))) +
      plot_annotation(title = sprintf(
        "%s, Sub-%s: permutation p %s;  absolute correlation of its BSR map with primary LV1 = %s, LV2 = %s",
        params$pls_runs[[rid]]$label, lv, format_pval(s$perm_p),
        sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", s$abs_r_primary_LV1)),
        sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", s$abs_r_primary_LV2))),
        tag_levels = "A",
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5))))
  })
  short <- params$pls_runs[[rid]]$short
  # Full figure (sub-LV1 and sub-LV2) in the run's own folder
  save_png(wrap_plots(rows, ncol = 1),
           run_path(seg, sprintf("reduced_block_%s_subLV1_subLV2.png", short)),
           width = 20, height = 24, dpi = 150)
  # Supplement: sub-LV1 only
  save_png(rows[[1]], numbered_path("Figure", params$pls_runs[[rid]]$figure,
                                    sprintf("%s_reduced_block.png", short)),
           width = 20, height = 12, dpi = 150)
}
```
